protocol.candidate: pre-encoded replayable Metal ICB graphs, with the known layer-30 Q4 Q and Q6 V stages remaining direct dispatches

repair_before_measurement.issue: The direct source lane opened a serial compute encoder before attempting ICB replay, and its mixed replay/direct/replay seam could leave an encoder active.

reason: The repaired graph is token-exact, but it encodes 610 commands per forward and runs about 3.77x slower than the established strict matched source lane. It receives no adjacent multi-trial speed promotion and remains double-gated diagnostic-only.
runtime_status: The replay path remains default-off and requires both explicitly named unsafe diagnostic flags.
reopen_condition: Revisit only with a graph that preserves the already-promoted source fused QKV/RoPE/KV, residual-norm, and gate/up stages while reducing physical encoder work below the 386-dispatch direct lane; validate P8 logits and a five-trial strict match before timing claims.
